name: Safety and control (careful reader, long)
angle: A careful reader who checks the licence, the terms and the protection tools before depositing.
intent_summary: Detailed brand-review page about the Longfu88 online casino for players from Singapore, written for a careful reader: who runs the casino and under which licence, the fact sheet, registration with account security and verification, the responsible-gambling tools, the welcome bonus with its terms, other promotions and VIP limits, payments with withdrawal timing, the game library, providers, the sportsbook, mobile access, support, a pros and cons table, an FAQ and a closing checklist. All brand facts come from the AffBulk knowledge base longfu88-new; nothing is claimed about the legal status of the casino in Singapore.

blocks.notes: A bulleted list of exactly 5 items, each a bold question followed by a short answer of 20-30 words, in this order: (1) how long identity verification takes (up to 10 days after a complete document set; up to 30 days to send the documents when requested); the question contains the keyword "Longfu 88" exactly once, written verbatim; (2) whether a player may have more than one account (no: one personal account per player, and the account must be registered with accurate information); (3) whether withdrawals carry fees (no standard casino fee; provider and blockchain fees may apply; a 10% commission with a minimum of €2.25 can apply where turnover is below the deposit, and 15% on some card or bank funded transactions); the answer contains the keyword "Longfu88" exactly once, written verbatim; (4) how long a withdrawal takes (card, crypto and wallet withdrawals 1 to 3 business days; bank transfer up to 3 business days of casino processing plus 3 to 5 business days of bank delivery; the wording must differ from the withdrawals section); (5) who may play (at least 18 years old and legally permitted to gamble in the place of residence).
